enemies.t: The final boss of VR: Special Training. Its chest and both legs share one HP bar, and status effects don't affect it. On Ultimate it moves faster.

The Machine boss of the quest VR Boss Training: Duga Dunga, in the Raids section of Episode 1, on Ultimate only. He has 70,000 HP for one player and 35,000 more for each extra player. Only hits on his core lower his HP, until enough hits on his legs make one give way and he topples for 10 seconds. He attacks with a jump press, homing mines, shell barrages, rolling attacks, chasing bombs and a leg laser, and four Gohma Dilla join his shell barrages.

g.t: Duga Dunga himself can drop it. Each player in the fight gets their own roll when he is defeated.

sd.t: They appear when he is defeated. Each container rolls once for each player in the fight: an item from one of these tiers at the rate shown, or else 500 to 5,000 Meseta.
Each of these has its own roll for each player, on top of the item or Meseta.

enemies.sf: Container chances are per container, for each player. This raid doubles every chance shown here. Other rare boosts don't change them.

enemies.t: A golden miniboss that only appears in the day's boosted episode. It fires tracking lasers and sprays Meseta. It always drops 100,000 Meseta on Normal, 200,000 on Hard and 500,000 on Very Hard; on Ultimate it rolls the rare rewards below instead.

The Native boss of the quest The Shelled Giant: Giel Zohg, in the Raids section of Episode 2, on Ultimate only. He has 140,000 HP for one player and 70,000 more for each extra player. He is also the last enemy of the quest The Shelled Giant, in the Mission section of Episode 2, on every difficulty. There he is weaker: on Ultimate he has 71,098 HP for one player and half as much again for each extra player, and he hits less hard. In Prestige Hunter mode he is as strong as in the raid. This giant crayfish fights on a round deck out at sea. He attacks with claw strikes that send out shock waves, a smash with both claws, a claw sweep, charging rushes that leave water bombs behind, a spin, rolling mines that can be destroyed, homing bubbles and damage zones that fall onto the deck. Breaking a claw or his shell exposes a weak point. At half HP he changes form, and his attacks change.

g.t: Giel Zohg himself can drop it. Each player in the fight gets their own roll when he is defeated.

sd.t: They appear when he is defeated. Each container rolls once for each player in the fight: an item from one of these tiers at the rate shown, or else 500 to 5,000 Meseta.
Each of these has its own roll for each player, on top of the item or Meseta.
They appear when he is defeated. On this difficulty each container may give each player in the fight one random drop, like an ordinary box.

enemies.t: It appears in the quest The Shelled Giant, in the Mission section of Episode 2, on every difficulty. A shark warrior with blade arms. It slashes, sweeps and leaps at you, and it can guard and strike back with a counter.

It appears in the quest The Shelled Giant, in the Mission section of Episode 2, on every difficulty. A Rappy in a snorkel and flippers. It pecks in quick combos, burrows into the sand to come up under you and dashes in for a flying attack.

It appears in the quest The Shelled Giant, in the Mission section of Episode 2, on every difficulty. An ice flower rooted to the ground. It bites, sends out sonic waves and fires volleys of ice. It can't be frozen.

It appears in the quest The Shelled Giant, in the Mission section of Episode 2, on every difficulty. A slim machine riding a hover board. It fires shots, boosts across the field and spins up a tornado. It can't be frozen, paralyzed or shocked.

It appears in the quest The Shelled Giant, in the Mission section of Episode 2, on every difficulty. A squid-like creature on tentacle legs. It attacks with bombs and leaps in with a jumping bomb attack. It can't be shocked.

It appears in the quest The Shelled Giant, in the Mission section of Episode 2, on every difficulty. A small round creature in a duck swim ring. It closes in with quick steps and dashes, and its combos can knock you down.

It appears in the quest The Shelled Giant, in the Mission section of Episode 2, on every difficulty. A big turtle with a spiked melon shell. It charges in a rolling dash, jumps to shake the ground and casts techniques. Its shell blocks all damage from the front. It can't be frozen, shocked or confused, and on Hard and above no status effect lands on it.

The Native boss of the quest The Secluded Valley: Dol Vaveer, in the Raids section of Episode 4, on Ultimate only. He has 150,000 HP for one player and 75,000 more for each extra player. He stands rooted like a great tree in the middle of the valley and never walks, while his two arms fly free. Hits on the arms deal half damage. He attacks with a twin drill sweep, arm energy balls, turning lightning columns, eight wood bombs that can be shot down, sweeping head lasers, a drill that chases across the floor, arm bullet volleys and a spiral shock wave. At 60% and 30% HP he staggers for 5 seconds, and his attacks change.
